name: security-review
description: Deep, agent-team-driven security review of one or more codebases. Coordinates a team of 14 specialized agents (recon, threat-modelling, vulnerability hunters, adversarial verifier, triage, chain-composer, report compiler) over a 7-phase workflow. Designed for Opus 4.7 with the 1M context window and very large inference budgets. State and progress are persisted to .security-review/<run-id>/ as markdown so reviews can run for hours and resume after interruption. Produces a vulnerability report with CVSS v3.1 scores, exploit scenarios, suggested remediations, and a concrete verification test plan per finding.
